fw_throughput_appmix_mbps.label: Firewall throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Firewall throughput is measured with App-ID and logging enabled, utilizing appmix transactions.
Results in this column were derived from a configuration using six PA-7500-DPC-A cards and two PA-7500-NPC-A cards.

threat_prevention_throughput_mbps.label: Threat Prevention throughput (appmix)
test_conditions: Threat Prevention throughput is measured with App-ID, IPS, antivirus, antispyware, WildFire, DNS Security, file blocking, and logging enabled, utilizing appmix transactions.
Results in this column were derived from a configuration using six PA-7500-DPC-A cards and two PA-7500-NPC-A cards.

concurrent_sessions.label: Max concurrent sessions
test_conditions: Max concurrent sessions are measured utilizing HTTP transactions.
Results in this column were derived from a configuration using six PA-7500-DPC-A cards and two PA-7500-NPC-A cards.

ipsec_throughput_mbps.label: IPsec VPN throughput
test_conditions: IPsec VPN throughput is measured with 64KB HTTP transactions and logging enabled.
Results in this column were derived from a configuration using six PA-7500-DPC-A cards and two PA-7500-NPC-A cards.

new_sessions_per_sec.label: New sessions per second
test_conditions: New sessions per second is measured with application override, utilizing 1 byte HTTP transactions.
Results in this column were derived from a configuration using six PA-7500-DPC-A cards and two PA-7500-NPC-A cards.

vsys_base.label: Virtual systems (base/max)
test_conditions: Adding virtual systems over base quantity requires a separately purchased license. NGFW Cluster A/A supports a maximum of 25 Virtual Systems.
Results in this column were derived from a configuration using six PA-7500-DPC-A cards and two PA-7500-NPC-A cards.
